provenance.positionSource: NASA PDS Mars 2020 Rover PLACES best_interp.csv through sol 1897
provenance.positionMethod: For each catalog sol interval, use the midpoint and the nearest rover localization available in PDS PLACES; for later sols use the nearest NASA traverse endpoint. These are rover positions, not image-camera pointing coordinates.
provenance.colorSelection: One natural-color cylindrical panorama preview per catalog entry; monochrome and anaglyph products excluded.
